assumptions.choice: Trigger Long when R_t < mu and Short when R_t > mu upon FT crossing threshold
assumptions.reason: The specification states that both long and short entries trigger when FT crosses above the threshold to bet on mean reversion. A return below the lookback mean indicates downward stress (reversion up -> Long), while a return above the mean indicates upward stress (reversion down -> Short).

assumptions.choice: Record month-end close on the first trading bar of a new month using the previous bar close
assumptions.reason: Prevents lookahead bias on daily bar data while accurately capturing the completed month's closing price.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate 2% stop-loss on every daily bar against low[0] (for Long) and high[0] (for Short)
assumptions.reason: Ensures risk management is continuously enforced daily relative to the executed entry price.

assumptions.choice: Use sample variance over 24 historical monthly returns as the scalar 1x1 covariance matrix
assumptions.reason: For a single asset, the covariance matrix reduces to a scalar variance, so inverse covariance matrix multiplication reduces to division by variance.
